Perhaps a web design you can start,
Or coding magic for your heart.

The function calls repeat without an end,
A tireless cycle that will never bend.
The counter spins and never finds its stop,
A ceaseless motion from the top to top.

The model learns the noise with eager glee,
Ignoring truth for vanity.

answer:
The chain and gears begin their turning bright,
With spinning wheels that conquer dark of night.
The pedals push with force, a steady strain,
And kinetic power flows through sun and rain.

When code is built with careful, steady hand,
Tests show the flaws across the shifting sand.
They catch the bugs before the users find,
A solid structure for the heart and mind.

A zmienna to ten skarb, co płynie wciąż,
Co zmienia swój kształt, choć wciąż trwa na wieść.
W równaniach tkwi, gdzie liczby się splatają,
I nowe wartości w nich się odnajdą.
